name: paper-reading-workflow
description: A paired academic-paper workflow for active reading notes and verified Obsidian archives.

interface.shortDescription: Active paper notes and verified Obsidian archives
interface.longDescription: Use paper-notes for pre-reading, companion self-tests, corrections, and critical post-reading notes; then use paper-reading-intake to verify primary evidence and create one canonical Markdown note plus one self-contained HTML report.
defaultPrompt: Use paper-notes to guide my active reading of this paper.
Use paper-reading-intake to archive this paper in Obsidian.
